snippet.title: Gunship - Amiga
snippet.description:
00:00 Loading and Intro
02:37 Game options
03:37 Mission Briefing
05:10 Gameplay
24:00 Debriefing

An AH-64A Apache flight simulator by Microprose. The Amiga version was released in 1989.
Although it retains the original Commodore 64 look and feel, the graphics are beautiful enough and the sound is good.
The flight model is satisfactory and probably the best compared to similar games for home micros.
